# Overview

This report reads pipeline outputs directly via the `{targets}` API. Run the
pipeline first in your R session:

```r
targets::tar_make()
```

Then render this Quarto document:

```bash
quarto render reports/
```

## Data Summary

```{r}
#| label: summary
# Helper to resolve project-root absolute paths regardless of current wd
is_abs_path <- function(p) {
  p <- as.character(p)
  grepl("^([A-Za-z]:|/|\\\\\\\\)", p)
}
resolve_proj_path <- function(p) {
  p <- as.character(p)
  if (length(p) == 0) {
    return(character(0))
  }
  out <- ifelse(is_abs_path(p), p, here::here(p))
  # normalise for Windows path separators
  normalizePath(out, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}
targets_store <- resolve_proj_path("_targets")
tar_read_proj <- function(name) {
  targets::tar_read_raw(name, store = targets_store)
}

validated <- tar_read_proj("validated_strict")
cfg       <- tar_read_proj("cfg")
sim_mode  <- tar_read_proj("sim_mode")

n_rows    <- nrow(validated)
n_sites   <- dplyr::n_distinct(validated$SITE)
n_adsid   <- dplyr::n_distinct(validated$ADSID)
site_types <- sort(unique(validated$SITE_TYPE))

list(
  n_rows = n_rows,
  n_sites = n_sites,
  n_dates = n_adsid,
  site_types = head(site_types, 8L),
  calibration = list(
    terrestrial_curve = cfg$calibration$terrestrial_curve,
    marine_curve = cfg$calibration$marine_curve,
    time_range = cfg$calibration$time_range
  ),
  simulation_mode = sim_mode
)
```

## Method Summaries (Overall)

```{r}
#| label: methods-overall
spd_tbl <- tar_read_proj("spd_summary")
fd_tbl  <- tar_read_proj("fd_summary")
kde_tbl <- tar_read_proj("kde_summary")

# Show quick peeks of each (first 6 rows only)
utils::head(spd_tbl)
utils::head(fd_tbl)
utils::head(kde_tbl)
```

### Figure: SPD/FD/KDE Overlay (Overall)

```{r}
#| label: fig-overall
#| fig-cap: "Overall SPD/FD/KDE overlay"
overall_path <- resolve_proj_path(tar_read_proj("fig_methods_overall"))
stopifnot(file.exists(overall_path))
knitr::include_graphics(overall_path)
```

## Figures by SITE_TYPE

```{r}
#| label: figs-by-sitetype
#| fig-cap: "SPD/FD/KDE overlays by SITE_TYPE"
#| fig-align: center
fig_paths <- as.character(unlist(tar_read_proj("fig_methods_by_site_type"), use.names = FALSE))
fig_paths <- resolve_proj_path(fig_paths)
fig_paths <- fig_paths[file.exists(fig_paths)]
if (length(fig_paths) > 0) knitr::include_graphics(fig_paths)
```

## Figures by SITE (subset)

```{r}
#| label: figs-by-site
```

```{r}
#| label: figs-by-site-montage

montage_path <- resolve_proj_path(tar_read_proj("fig_methods_by_site_montage"))
```

## Reproducibility Notes

- Figures and tables reflect the configured calibration curves and time range:
  `terrestrial = cfg$calibration$terrestrial_curve`,
  `marine = cfg$calibration$marine_curve`,
  `time_range = cfg$calibration$time_range`.
- All inputs are derived from targets; there are no ad‑hoc file reads here.

# Simulations

```{r}
#| label: sims-summary
sim_mf <- tar_read_proj("sim_manifest")
if (identical(sim_mode, "demo")) {
  list(
    mode = sim_mode,
    source = "Generated locally from the filtered dataset with reduced demo settings.",
    iterations = cfg$simulate$demo$iterations,
    scenarios = sim_mf[, c("scenario", "size", "origin")]
  )
} else if (identical(sim_mode, "precomputed")) {
  list(
    mode = sim_mode,
    source = paste("Read from", cfg$simulate$precomputed$dir),
    scenarios = sim_mf[, c("scenario", "size", "origin")]
  )
} else {
  "Simulations disabled in config."
}
```

```{r}
#| label: sims-figs
#| fig-cap: "Simulation overlays by scenario"
if (!identical(sim_mode, "none")) {
  sim_figs <- as.character(unlist(tar_read_proj("fig_sim_overlays"), use.names = FALSE))
  sim_figs <- resolve_proj_path(sim_figs)
  sim_figs <- sim_figs[file.exists(sim_figs)]
  if (length(sim_figs) > 0) knitr::include_graphics(sim_figs)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: sims-montage
#| fig-cap: "Simulation montage"
if (!identical(sim_mode, "none")) {
  sim_montage <- resolve_proj_path(tar_read_proj("fig_sim_montage"))
  if (file.exists(sim_montage)) knitr::include_graphics(sim_montage)
}
```
